status: final evaluation complete; do not tune on these results
selection: latest observation no later than horizon
series_limitation: No series IDs; complete UTC dates grouped; teams may recur
final_test_policy: No final test predictions until development and protocol freeze are complete
temporal_rule: Match clock from combat events; preceding raw tick states; active matches only
team_rule: Verified hero name to metadata draft; never infer side from replay slot order
primary_comparison: logistic versus neural_network; raw probabilities; seed averaged predictions for paired intervals
calibration_reporting: Always report raw and temperature adjusted probabilities; no choice using final outcomes
bootstrap_reporting: Match bootstrap per model; paired match and UTC day block bootstrap for primary comparison; descriptive intervals conditional on data
matched_cohort_reporting: Also report the neural model on common final matches observed at all horizons
conditional_hero_extension: Deferred: retrospective role timing provenance and generic inventory values prevent a defensible prospective extension in this study
